_comment: Canonical MCP wiring for the OpenClaw ↔ MPM integration.
Source of truth for the OpenClaw runtime: configure via
openclaw config set mcp.servers.mpm.command "$HOME/.mpm/bin/mpm-mcp"
openclaw config set mcp.servers.mpm.env.MPM_WORKSPACE "$HOME/.mpm"
openclaw config set mcp.servers.mpm.env.MPM_PROVENANCE_FRAMEWORK "openclaw"
MPM_ACTIVE_MODE / MPM_ACTIVE_PERSONA are intentionally NOT set here.
MPM resolves mode/persona from env at request time via
internal/core/mpmcli.ActiveContextFromEnv() and falls back to its
own default/default contract when unset. Hardcoding framework-
specific defaults at install/MCP-wiring time was a pre-2026-08-29
drift that leaked an old mode taxonomy into every registration.
PROVENANCE: MPM_PROVENANCE_FRAMEWORK=openclaw MUST be set on the
mpm-mcp launch env so OpenClaw-authored writes are attributed to
the openclaw framework instead of the generic 'mcp' transport
default. Without this, recent_activity and artifact_provenance
record framework_name='mcp' for every OpenClaw-driven call, which
loses the host identity that contextual routing relies on.
The plugin's resolve_exec_env hook handles the shell-out path
(env-var injection on every exec tool call); the MCP path is
covered here at the mpm-mcp launch boundary instead. Both paths
now converge on framework_name='openclaw' in tool_invocations.
or merge this file directly via the OpenClaw MCP import path.
Validation: 2026-08-19 alpha-integration-test, all four surfaces passed.
Replaces the stale relative-path entry that previously lived at
~/.mpm/.mcp.json (now flagged as an MPM-side defect, NOT silently
edited here per the 'no MPM core edits' boundary).
Path placeholders: substitute $HOME for your user home; the canonical
install layout places mpm-mcp at $HOME/.mpm/bin/mpm-mcp and the
MPM workspace at $HOME/.mpm (overridable via MPM_WORKSPACE).
